# Product Designer at Brightpath, Berlin

Brightpath is a 60-person health-tech company in Berlin. We build tools that make healthcare simpler for patients and the clinicians who care for them. We're growing and need a Product Designer to join the team.

## What you'll do
- Own design projects end to end, from discovery and research to shipped interfaces
- Create flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs in Figma
- Work closely with product managers, engineers, and clinical experts
- Test ideas with real users and use what you learn to improve the product
- Contribute to our design system and help it evolve

## What you bring
- Solid experience designing digital products, ideally in health or another regulated space
- Strong Figma skills and a user-centered process
- Clear communication and a collaborative mindset

## What we offer
- Salary of €70,000–€85,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid setup: 3 days a week in our Berlin office
- A small team where your work has visible impact

Interested? Send us your portfolio and a short note about a project you're proud of.
